scope.description: All text input items in one native turn; separate instructions are excluded.

reported_source.description: Redacted credential source the vendor's startup frame reported.

request_refusal.description: Vendor-attested request refusal that stops retries and account rotation on its harness; input, executable and credential-source causes carry their own evidence.

anyOf.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

requested.description: Original effort preference before adaptation; null when none was requested.

submitted.description: Native option prepared for transport; null means omitted, never the explicit token none. Not proof of dispatch.

parameter.description: Native carrier, such as reasoning.effort, model_reasoning_effort or --effort; null when no separate knob is carried.

observed.description: Provider-reported effort only; null when unobserved, never copied from submission.

observedSource.description: Provider event/field that reported observed effort; null when unobserved.

reason.description: Diagnostic explanation; consumers branch on resolution, never prose.

anyOf.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

requested.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

submitted.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

submittedNative.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

reason.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

processing.description: Requested intent, submitted native control, and observed execution are independent facts. A submitted flag never proves observed service; mixed or missing session observations remain explicit.

nativeMode.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

debit.description: The route reports no actual cash or purchased-credit debit. Included service still admits the work, but its cash stays unknown instead of zero and is outside the finite cap; absence keeps proven ordinary inclusion as zero cash.

processing_cost_basis.description: Mode-qualified billing evidence for an existing cost record. Authentication alone does not establish included premium service; credits, cash, and token valuation stay distinct.

anyOf.description: Native prompt-cache lifetime for the main conversation and helper requests of a harness that declares it. Omission sends no override: native defaults, profile settings and the inherited environment stay in effect.

requested.description: Lifetime the engine routed to this session: the run's captured value where this adapter declares it, otherwise null (Default, or an undeclared value disclosed as ignored). The captured intent itself is the task contract's prompt_cache_ttl.

submitted.description: Value set on the native lifetime controls of this process, null when none was set. Configuration, not proof that the provider applied it.

reason.description: Known reason the submitted value cannot govern this session (a forcing or disabling native control in effect, or a CLI that predates the controls); null when none is known.

observed.description: Lifetime split of the cache writes reported by the native result usage; it does not establish which request buckets that usage aggregates. none = no observed writes (not disabled caching); unknown = a result did not report the split.

write_5m_tokens.description: Reported five-minute cache-write tokens summed over results; null when any result omitted the split.

write_1h_tokens.description: Reported one-hour cache-write tokens summed over results; null when any result omitted the split.

prompt_cache_ttl.description: Requested, configured and observed prompt-cache lifetime facts for one attempt. Lifecycle, outcome and cost are separate facts and never derive from this receipt.

type.description: Normalized event type covering session lifecycle, output, tool use, interaction, file changes, usage, transient status, context-management signals, and errors.

final.description: True on the harness's typed final-answer message (vendor terminal result); mid-run narration never sets it.

key.description: Opaque adapter-issued key of one observed text block; equality only.

op.description: fragment: a verbatim streamed piece of the keyed text block; complete: the harness's complete text of that block (at most once per key); abandoned: the harness stated the block will never be completed (partial fragments stay as emitted).

speech.description: Adapter-issued speech identity of a text event (fragment/complete on messages, abandoned on a status event); absent when no block lifecycle was exactly observed. A typed final never carries it unless the adapter proves the link.

name.description: Native tool name as the harness reports it.

kind.description: Coarse tool classification used for typed governance; adapters map native tool names to a kind.

use_id.description: Correlates a tool_result with its tool_call.

target.description: Bounded human-readable target (query/url/path/command), as the agent issued it.

status.description: Outcome of the tool use; required on tool_result events (a missing status is never treated as ok).

phase.description: Native lifecycle frame of a file_change (started or completed); absent when the adapter does not type it. Completion is not success: the outcome stays in status.

error_summary.description: Error detail for status=error results: the tool's own output, unmasked, within the adapter's bound and whitespace normalization.

content_summary.description: Content detail for results (success or failure), unmasked, within the adapter's bound and whitespace normalization.

exit_code.description: Process exit code for command tools, when known.

state.description: exited: the tool observed the command end; timed_out: the tool's timeout elapsed before an observed end (the process may still run or may have been signalled); backgrounded: the command was handed to a background shell and was still running when the result returned; unknown: the native result established none of these.

signal.description: Vendor-reported signal name of an exited command.

timeout_ms.description: The elapsed tool timeout behind timed_out or a timeout-driven background handoff.

background_reason.description: Why a backgrounded command left the foreground: its timeout or a request.

shell_id.description: Vendor handle of the background shell that kept the command.

command_outcome.description: Command process facts (#450), separate from status; absent means not reported.

web_retrieval.description: Adapter-stamped web/browser retrieval outcome (verified/dispatched/failed), distinct from the tool-call status lifecycle.

tool.description: Typed tool info; set on tool_call and tool_result events.

interaction_id.description: Interaction id used to correlate the answer set.

header.description: Short chip/header text some harnesses attach to a question.

label.description: Option label shown to the user.

description.description: Optional longer explanation of the option.

items.description: One multiple-choice option of an interactive question.

options.description: Selectable options; empty for free-text-only questions.

multi_select.description: Whether multiple options may be selected.

items.description: One question of an interactive user-input request.

source_tool.description: Native tool that raised the request (e.g. "AskUserQuestion").

context_packet_hash.description: Content hash in algo:hex form, e.g. "sha256:abcd...".

expected_blob_oid.description: Base-tree blob oid, or null only when the path is absent in the base tree.

patch_envelope.description: Typed hash-bound patch produced by a git-patch-envelope harness.

refusal_code.description: Typed refusal code for a rejected raw patch contract.

estimated_request_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the whole rendered request (chars/4, plus a fixed figure per image); never a tokenizer count.

model.description: Model whose catalog row was consulted; null when the producer reported none.

framing_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the request outside this packet; null when unmeasured.

selection_limit_tokens.description: Limit the optional selection honoured: the packet's share of the window, or the assumed ceiling on file contents.

omitted_for_budget.description: Optional files left out to honour selection_limit_tokens (listed in omissions).

mandatory_paths.description: Project mandatory files, each delivered complete in readable_files.

budget.description: Sizing evidence for a raw context packet; disclosed, never a tokenizer count.

raw_context.description: Set on the status event that discloses, just before the POST, how a raw-api request was sized (#147).

permission_denial.description: Adapter-attested native tool permission refusal, not a claim inferred from model prose or empty output. Does not grant broader access.

cached_input_tokens.description: Reported cache token count; relation to input_tokens is harness-specific.

input_token_usage.description: Complete reported input total, including cache reads/writes, and its separately measured cache subsets. Null means unknown, never zero or a partial sum.

cost_basis.description: Observed meaning of this usage.cost_usd amount, separate from prospective processing billing. List-price valuation is not a cash or credit debit receipt. Native paid-credit consumption remains unknown when the vendor exposes no amount evidence.

estimated.description: True when cost_usd is derived from token pricing (not natively reported).

usage.description: Token/cost usage reported by the harness.

observed_model.description: Model the harness actually reported using.

label.description: The observed model string, byte-identical to observed_model on the same event and to the matched entry's catalog label.

id.description: Id of the only catalog entry whose label is exactly `label`; no other entry has `label` as its id.

source.description: The model list the spawn's own account answered before the vendor process ran.

profile_id.description: Credential profile whose catalog answered (the spawn's profile); null = engine-default credentials.

observed_model_catalog_match.description: Stamped by the per-spawn model gate from that spawn's own account catalog; adapters never set it, and the gate strips any value it did not compute.

credential_route.description: Concrete credential route selected before spawn; first-class route evidence, never inferred from free-form payload text.

credential_source.description: Concrete credential source selected before spawn; exact native subscription requires native_session, never an OAuth token or API key.

credential_profile_id.description: Credential profile the attempt runs under; absent = engine-default credentials (INV-135 attribution).

account_usage.description: Native informational overage diagnostics translated by the adapter; never inference admission authority.

source.description: Machine-readable source of quota evidence, classified by schema-owned traits.

applies_to_request_kinds.description: Vendor-declared operation scope. Absent applies to both text and image; model scope still applies independently.

items.description: One independent vendor quota window; without model ids or declared prefixes it applies to every model, and null usage stays unknown.

quota.description: All quota windows from a vendor-owned machine-readable source; never scraped from prose or collapsed into a fake aggregate.

plan_progress.description: Typed live plan/todo progress mapped from the harness's native plan tools, never parsed from prose.

constraint_id.description: Vendor-owned rate-window identity, when the adapter can map it from a typed field.

applies_to_models.description: Canonical model ids/aliases this rejection applies to; omitted/null (with no prefixes) means every model.

applies_to_model_prefixes.description: Producer-declared model-family prefixes this rejection also applies to, as on QuotaConstraint.

resets_at.description: When the rate window resets, when reported.

retry_delay_ms.description: Suggested retry delay in milliseconds, when reported.

rate_limit.description: Typed rate-limit/quota signal set by the adapter when the native CLI reports a 429/quota/overload.

retry_delay_ms.description: Delay before the retry, when reported.

error_category.description: Vendor error category mapped onto the normalized enum; unrecognized values collapse to 'unknown' (never free-form prose).

status.description: Typed transient-status detail set by the adapter on status events.

retry_delay_ms.description: Suggested retry delay in milliseconds, when reported.

transient.description: Typed transient-failure signal set by the adapter from native CLI/API error shapes, consumed for bounded retry policy.

kind.description: Kind of context signal: a compaction boundary starting/completing, or terminal capacity exhaustion.

cause.description: Why the context signal fired, mapped onto a typed cause (never prose).

native_code.description: The vendor's own terminal/context code passed verbatim as evidence; null when none.

trigger.description: Whether the compaction was manually or automatically triggered; null when unreported.

pre_tokens.description: Token count before the compaction/exhaustion, when the vendor reports it; null otherwise.

context.description: Typed context-management signal (compaction boundary / capacity exhaustion) set by the adapter; orthogonal to the transient-retry taxonomy.

aborted.description: Typed terminal cancellation marker, set on completed events when the run was aborted.

HarnessEvent.description: Normalized event emitted by every adapter (the SSOT of adapter output).
